cohort: 30 women with post-Cesarean section Abdominal Wall Endometriomas (AWE)
finding: Wide surgical excision with a margin of less than 1 cm for post-Cesarean section Abdominal Wall Endometriomas (AWE) was found to be an effective treatment with no recurrences observed, and preoperative cytological biopsy is recommended to confirm the diagnosis.
mod_finding: The study focuses on Abdominal Wall Endometriomas (AWE) as a complication of Cesarean Section and suggests that wide surgical excision with a margin of less than 1 cm is an effective treatment.
